svg.aria-label: Val Ark: every page, as a tree
svg.title: Val Ark: every page, as a tree
svg.desc: A map of every Val Ark guide as a branching tree, four levels deep: the README leads to the docs map, the workshop guides, the policies and the AI-agent manuals; the docs map branches into the guides, the design hierarchy and the knowledge base. Branches draw in level by level.
svg.text: Start at the left and follow a branch to any guide.
